module_summary: Destination data path of a clearable CDC gray FIFO: muxes the async storage array by read index and registers it through a flushable spill register.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: FIFO storage contents from source domain, indexed by dst_ridx_i.

anchors.name: dst_ridx_i
anchors.why: Read index selecting the FIFO entry from async_data_i.

anchors.name: dst_data
anchors.why: Selected FIFO entry fed into the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_valid_i
anchors.why: Pointer-side valid entering spill register, masked by clear.

anchors.name: dst_ready_o
anchors.why: Spill register ready returned to the pointer logic.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination output valid from the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Destination consumer ready into the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Registered output data from the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_clear_i
anchors.why: Clear request flushing the spill register and blocking input valid.

groups.name: read_mux
groups.description: Selects FIFO entry from async storage array by read index.

groups.name: spill_register
groups.description: Flushable spill register cutting the combinational path to the destination.
